basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Wellness Therapist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) is recruiting candidates for 2 vacancies for the Wellness Therapist post on a contract basis for a period of 01 year. The qualification required for the Wellness Therapist post is MPhil and MA/ MSc in Clinical Psychology OR MA/ Msc in Clinical Psychology. The pay is Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 60,000 (Highly Skilled) consolidated per month. Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the ONLINE application mode up to the last date of 23 October 2026. The selected candidate will be required to reside in the Students Hostel in the campus, II

how_to_apply: Check the official advertisement and ensure eligibility criteria are met.
Submit the application through the designated online application process before the last date of October 23, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: MPhil and MA/ MSc in Clinical Psychology OR MA/ Msc in Clinical Psychology. Desirable Qualification: M.phil in Clinical Psychology/Mphil in Rehabilitation Psychology. Minimum Experience: 01 to 03 years of experience in a hospital/Psychiatry Clinic or an educational Institution. The experience may be relaxed for meritorious candidates.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is ₹50,000/- to ₹60,000/- per month as a Highly Skilled position. The period of engagement is 01 year, with extension based on performance. The Wellness Therapist will be required to reside in the Students Hostel in the campus and must be available to attend to emergencies at any time.
